title: the_coworker_who_finished_my_run
display_title: My coworker uploaded my parkour run one hour before I did — with my mistakes fixed
beats: My coworker uploaded my parkour run one hour before I could — with every single one of my mistakes already fixed.
I'd been grinding this seed for six weeks, 34F, recording every attempt on my phone propped against a monitor at work during lunch breaks.
Only one person knew my login: Priya (26F), who watched me practice the same three jumps for a month straight.
Her upload had my exact route, my exact skin — but the missed jump at 2:14 that I always botched was suddenly perfect.
I confronted her and she just smiled and said, 'I finished it for you. You're welcome.'
The video still hasn't come down, and she still sits two desks away from me. Was I wrong to report her?
